purpose: Pairwise cross-check of audit_v3 ISOLATED ranking; corroborates μ-v4 iter 4 +2.75 absolute lift over σ
method: Opus 4.7 pairwise judge, position-randomized, NeurIPS/ICLR-grade reviewer rubric (concrete substance > formatting). Each pair anonymized — judge sees only goal + 2 plans, no labels.

matchups.interpretation: PRIMARY cross-check. Opus pairwise prefers μ-v4 in 6/8 anonymized comparisons → audit_v3 ISOLATED +2.75 absolute lift CORROBORATED at the ≥6/8 threshold. Position-bias check passes (50% A-pos, perfectly balanced).

Close-cluster ranking confirmed: μ-v4 cleanly above δ. Note: this REVERSES the Phase 0.6 finding (μ-v2 lost 0-8 to δ) — μ-v4's broad-spectrum lift over μ-v2 transfers to pairwise dominance even against the privileged δ baseline (which sees the reference plan in its prompt).
Close-cluster ranking confirmed: μ-v4 cleanly above α (Opus distillation). Validates that SDPO+critic adds value over naive distillation.

rationale_themes: Concrete hyperparameters (β=4 or 8, ρ=0.2, ε_low=0.8/ε_high=1.2, K=100) cited as deciding factor
Named tools/baselines (RS-GRPO, SIFT, TTRL, MiGrATe, AlphaProof, AlphaEvolve, LLaMA3.2-1B, AIME-2024, 67-problem benchmark)

μ-v4's losses (4/24): pair_00 / pair_01 / pair_03 / pair_07 of vs σ where μ-v4 plans had template-leakage artifacts (literal \n escapes, Insight-template tokens) and σ produced cleaner concrete-content plans
verdict: PASS — pairwise CORROBORATES audit_v3 ISOLATED on the primary +2.75 claim (6-2 ≥ 6/8 threshold) and confirms close-cluster ranking μ-v4 ≫ {σ, δ, α} (7-1 each). Paper-claim headline ('first 30B-trained variant to beat σ') is now backed by both absolute and pairwise evidence.
limitations: n=8 per matchup; binomial 95% CI on 6-2 ≈ [35%, 97%], on 7-1 ≈ [47%, 100%] — directional but wide
Single goal (TTT-Discover); cross-goal validation deferred to Phase 3
Opus 4.7 is the same evaluator family as audit_v3 — not a fully independent judge
